description: Reviews bulk mutation commands from the master-of (mo) CLI — parking every unparked skill, confirming every pending classification, regenerating AGY gate skills, and toggling Cowork packs — before they run. Diagnostic and inspection commands (mo doctor, mo status/check, mo full, mo search) are not matched by this extension and stay unreviewed.
name: master-of command protection
saferAlternatives: Park or classify one named component at a time and review the change before running --all.
Generate AGY gates into a scratch directory first and diff before overwriting the real gate skills directory.
Pass an explicit domain and run `mo cowork list` before toggling Cowork packs.
